Add E2E tests for DAG Runs tab functionality.

## Changes
- Added `data-testid` to [DagRuns.tsx](cci:7://file:///Users/sahilshadwal/Desktop/airflow/airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/src/pages/DagRuns.tsx:0:0-0:0) for E2E testing
- Extended [DagsPage.ts](cci:7://file:///Users/sahilshadwal/Desktop/airflow/airflow-core/src/airflow/ui/tests/e2e/pages/DagsPage.ts:0:0-0:0) with 7 methods for Runs tab interactions
- Created test suite with 4 test cases covering navigation, display, filtering, search, and pagination

## Test Coverage
✅ Navigate to Runs tab  
✅ Verify run details (ID, state, times, duration)  
✅ Click run to view details  
✅ Filter and search functionality  
✅ Pagination

Closes #59541 

Related issues: #59028
